subject: Adora Therapeutics — Vendor onboarding: banking letter, PO mapping & remittance format
messages:
From: Sarah Lam <sarah.lam@adora.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@adora.co
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Adora vendor onboarding packet — bank letter + W-9

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick onboarding checklist. Attached are the bank verification letter and our current W-9. We completed the vendor intake form this morning and included our preferred payment method (ACH). A couple of notes: 

- Currency: USD (payments from Redwood will be USD).
- Our AP team prefers invoices to include the Redwood PO number in the invoice header and the PO line reference in the remittance CSV under the invoice_reference field.

Attachments included: Adora_BankLetter_20260507.pdf (bank letter, signed), Adora_W9_20260507.pdf (W-9).

Please confirm next steps and whether you need a micro-deposit verification or any additional proof for the wire path. Also confirm the PO format your system uses so we can map invoices correctly.

Best,
Sarah Lam
Accounts Payable Manager
Adora Therapeutics
[Attachment: Adora_BankLetter_20260507.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Adora_W9_20260507.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lam <sarah.lam@adora.co>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Adora vendor onboarding packet — bank letter + W-9

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending. Looping in Priyom and Marissa from FinOps to finalize routing and PO mapping. Quick checklist items from our side: 

1) Micro-deposit: We can accept either a micro-deposit verification or a bank letter. Your letter looks fine at a glance, but FinOps will confirm whether we need a micro-deposit for ACH activation.
2) PO reference: Our billing system requires a single PO number in the invoice header and a separate free-text invoice_reference (up to 40 chars) for remittance matching. Example: PO: RW-2026-2741; invoice_reference: ADORA-INV-12345.
3) Remit CSV: Can you provide a 1-row CSV sample mapping invoice_reference -> remittance_label? That helps avoid manual rework.

Priyom/Marissa — can you validate the bank letter and confirm if micro-deposit is required, and if so expected timeline? Also confirm when the first PO will be issued so we can schedule the first payment.

Thanks — I’ll hold for the FinOps confirmation and then share final onboarding steps and the DocuSign for vendor acceptance.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Procurement
Redwood Inference
[Signature]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Sarah Lam <sarah.lam@adora.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Adora vendor onboarding packet — bank letter + W-9

On Thu, May 7, 2026 at 10:02 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for sending. Looping in Priyom and Marissa from FinOps to finalize routing and PO mapping.

Hi all — reviewed the bank letter and W-9. Bank letter includes account holder name, routing number, and bank contact — good. We do require a micro-deposit for ACH activation when the account name on the bank letter does not exactly match the legal vendor name on file. The vendor intake shows the legal name as 'Adora Therapeutics, Inc.' which matches the W-9, so micro-deposit optional but we recommend it for early payments (one-time verification).

Sarah — if you can send a 1-row CSV sample for the remittance mapping (comma-delimited, header row: invoice_number, invoice_reference, remittance_label) that would help. If you prefer we can provide a template. Expected timeline: if you confirm CSV today we can complete onboarding in 48 hours and enable ACH by Mon, May 11. If you prefer micro-deposit instead, that typically adds 3 business days.

Marissa — once we have the sample and confirm account activation, please prepare the PO RW-2026-2741 and set payment terms (Net 30 by default). Sarah — please confirm Net 30 is acceptable.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Financial Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: FinOps_remit_template.csv (csv)]

From: Sarah Lam <sarah.lam@adora.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@adora.co
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Adora vendor onboarding packet — bank letter + W-9

Thanks Priyom — attaching the one-row CSV sample and confirming Net 30 is fine. We prefer ACH and are happy to skip micro-deposit since the bank letter and W-9 match; if you still prefer a micro-deposit, we can do it but would prefer the faster enablement.

CSV sample attached: adora_remit_csv_sample.csv (columns: invoice_number, invoice_reference, remittance_label). Example row: 2026-0001, ADORA-INV-1001, ADORA-1001-PO1

Next steps we’d like from Redwood:
- Confirm PO number and send PO pdf to accounts-payable@adora.co (we’ll attach PO to invoice).
- Confirm ACH enablement date (target May 11 preferred).
- Share any specific invoice header requirements or PDF naming convention.

Once enabled, please send a confirmation email with the first payment ETA and remittance CSV sample for that payment.

Best,
Sarah Lam
Accounts Payable Manager
Adora Therapeutics
[Attachment: adora_remit_csv_sample.csv (csv)]
